hypothesis: A bank that keeps a naturally asked question and another speaker's reply together may help the eventual reader, but literal self-matching can make pairs look artificially good. Estimate both effects on the current span before selecting the unchanged third writer slot. No benchmark question, answer or evidence enters the features.
probes: For each turn containing a literal question, extract the last nonempty question through its question mark. Use the immediately following different-speaker turn as a weak reply. Require a second turn by that reply speaker. Compare the true reply's reciprocal rank at five to the mean for all other same-speaker targets. For a sham, replace the target by the next same-speaker turn cyclically, with identical probes, vectors and rankings. Rank actual single/paired dated 96-word chunks within the current span, stably breaking ties in native order. Also rerank after removing exactly the asker's indexed words from every candidate and dropping empty chunks. A turn counts only at its highest ranked occurrence.
features: paired minus single excess reciprocal rank, intact
paired minus single excess reciprocal rank, query turn removed
fraction of eligible probes whose target shares a native pair with the query minus one half
eligible probes divided by available adjacent turn boundaries
fit: Use zeros for spans without eligible probes. Freeze the existing ridge and policy temperature. Leave one entire dialogue out including for stage-two supervision. Fit root and terminal from the same original 12 factorial windows / 91 questions (session 5-8), with verified rule-2 terminal receipts after parser repair, root overlap and cross-fitted continuation. Comparators are the identical real-source learner with raw rewards only, the scrambled-target credit learner, a donor-matched constant logit shift per node, the previous repaired-credit policy, native and terminal PPO. Use recorded actual native logits, both paths' exact predecision source and ordered skills, per-question native reader F1 and logical usage.
evaluation: Freeze before scoring the model against recorded paths. Keep all 52 randomized later pairs / 466 questions as they finish; report prior vs strictly post-fit branch scores and the 40-window / 378-question session-13+ temporal block separately. Four-path calibration and all later windows from the six training histories are diagnostics. Report focal and joint design-weighted F1 on randomized pairs. A candidate for independent development needs at least 90% of the 378 later questions and four histories, a prospective sample, a 0.02 focal F1 gain versus native and terminal, positive focal difference over all other controls, and positive joint difference over native. Formal promotion requires fresh representative held-out histories as in the parent protocol.
